Text:
'm Mawadda Al Khorchani, a 19-year-old third-year Computer Science student at the Rotterdam University of Applied Sciences . I have chosen this major because as a highschooler I wanted to be an engineer and because I somewhat enjoyed coding. A lot of people in my field at the time warned me that I should not choose Computer Science unless I genuinely enjoy it. 

I was taught the basics and I indeed found out through a series of events regarding my studies, if I want to succeed as a software developer and engineer, I have to find my passion, interest and joy in what I do. After being lost for some time I decided to start on personal software development to improve my technical skills. This is my first hobby project and start of a journey to succeed in this field. 

I am excited and I hope you enjoy following my journey through this website, since I am creating a page on this website with links and descriptions TO my future projects. I will also describe my growth and lessons through updates on this website. Let's see what the future has for me!
